{{recipesummary|category=Cake recipes|yield=12 slices|time=2 hours|difficulty=2}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cake|Cake]]

'''Apple bundt cake''' is very easy to make, requires no fancy frosting or filling, and is delicious for serving at breakfast, tea time or even as a birthday cake with a chocolate or fruit glaze covering.

==Ingredients==
*2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] (450 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 16 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) white granulated [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
*Zest of 1 [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]]
*4 [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*1 cup (250 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] / 8.5 fl oz) [[Cookbook:Vegetable oil|vegetable oil]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]]
*2 cups (275 g / 9.7 oz) [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
*½ tsp [[Cookbook:Allspice|allspice]]
*½ tsp [[Cookbook:Nutmeg|nutmeg]]
*2 tsp [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
*2 tsp [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|baking soda]]
*1 tsp [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*1 tsp [[Cookbook:Cinnamon|cinnamon]]
*3 large tart [[Cookbook:Apple|apple]]s, [[Cookbook:Grater|grated]]
*½ cup (40 g / 1.4 oz) [[Cookbook:Raisin|raisin]]s

==Procedure==
#Mix quickly the sugar and lemon rind in a [[Cookbook:Food Processor|food processor]].
#Add eggs and blend until it becomes a nice cream.
#Continue blending while slowly adding the oil. Blend until well mixed and add vanilla.
#In a separate bowl sift the dry ingredients all together (flour, allspice, nutmeg, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cinnamon).
#Mix the dry ingredients slowly into the batter, blending until it becomes nice and thick.
#Add grated apples and blend quickly into batter just to mix. Be sure not to overblend and shred the apples too much.
#Add raisins, and pulse the processor as to just mix them in and not shred them.
#Bake in a bundt pan for 55 minutes at approximately [[Cookbook:Oven_temperatures|320°F (160°C; gas mark 3)]] or until a knife inserted into the center comes out clean.
